# Security policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue** for a security problem. Use GitHub's
private reporting instead: on the repository page, open the **Security** tab
and choose **Report a vulnerability**.

If that option is not available yet, open an issue that only asks for a
private contact, without any details of the problem.

## Scope

Irradia is a personal project maintained by one person. The app is not
published online yet: today it only runs locally with `npm run dev`. Reports
about the code in this repository, its dependencies or its CI configuration are
welcome.

There is no guaranteed response time, and there is no bug bounty.
